name: Shioba
source:
A former high-ranking Alliance agent who now serves as the resistance's scout and assassin, Shioba is a skilled human fighter with a dark past.

His partnership with Yamasumi is the best bliss he could ever ask for, and he would do anything to protect his family.

Likes: His family, combat training, poison-making

Dislikes: Human Alliance, judgmental people, Yamasumi when he's drunk

[From the [url=https://arashi.eccentric-studio.org/en/characters/shioba]official description[/url]]
